contributions: Voyager's automatic curriculum, executable skill library, and iterative environment feedback jointly support sustained in-context exploration in Minecraft.

method.summary: A prompted GPT-4 agent uses automatic task generation, executable JavaScript skills, retrieval, code execution, and self-verification.

findings.finding: Voyager's automatic curriculum, executable skill library, and iterative environment feedback jointly support sustained in-context exploration in Minecraft.
